nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for the standalone Cline CLI history source, re-exporting the history-reading submodule that parses per-session JSON transcripts under ~/.cline/data/sessions.

nodes.name: app.rs
nodes.summary: Core parser for OpenAI Codex CLI JSONL session transcripts: discovers session files, parses metadata and message history, reverse-engineers shell exec calls (rg/sed/nl/head/tail/cat) into structured file-read and search tool calls, and normalizes everything into canonical session/activity records.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains an extensive hand-rolled shell-token parser that recovers structured file-read/search intents from raw exec command strings, since Codex logs shell invocations rather than structured tool calls.

nodes.name: CodexTranscriptLocator
nodes.summary: Identifies the on-disk transcript file and session id used to resolve a Codex session's raw JSONL source.

nodes.name: list_codex_app_sessions_paginated
nodes.summary: Lists cached Codex app sessions in a paginated page for the sidebar.

nodes.name: list_codex_app_recent_paths
nodes.summary: Returns the most recently touched Codex session file paths for fast-path change detection.

nodes.name: load_codex_app_for_session
nodes.summary: Loads full session history for a single Codex session id from the on-disk transcript.

nodes.name: sync_codex_app_cache
nodes.summary: Synchronizes the Codex app session cache by discovering, parsing, and upserting all on-disk session records.

nodes.name: discover_codex_app_records
nodes.summary: Discovers all Codex session files under known session directories and returns parsed cache inputs.

nodes.name: collect_codex_session_files
nodes.summary: Recursively collects Codex session JSONL files from a directory into an output vector.

nodes.name: load_codex_session_index
nodes.summary: Loads and parses the Codex session index file that maps thread ids to titles and timestamps.

nodes.name: codex_source_fingerprint
nodes.summary: Computes a stable fingerprint for a Codex session record used to detect changes between syncs.

nodes.name: codex_session_index_title_for_record
nodes.summary: Looks up a human-readable session title from the Codex session index for a given record.

nodes.name: codex_thread_id_from_file_stem
nodes.summary: Extracts the Codex thread id embedded in a session transcript file's stem.

nodes.name: is_uuid_like
nodes.summary: Checks whether a string looks like a UUID, used to validate extracted thread/session identifiers.

nodes.name: parse_codex_session_meta
nodes.summary: Parses a raw Codex JSONL record into structured session metadata (model, cwd, timestamps, token counts).

nodes.name: session_meta_to_cache_input
nodes.summary: Converts parsed Codex session metadata into the cache input shape used by the imported-history cache layer.

nodes.name: parent_thread_id_from_session_meta_payload
nodes.summary: Extracts a parent thread id reference from a Codex session metadata payload, if the session is a continuation.

nodes.name: normalize_parent_thread_id_candidate
nodes.summary: Validates and normalizes a candidate parent thread id, rejecting self-references and malformed values.

nodes.name: resolve_codex_transcript_for_thread_id_near_path
nodes.summary: Resolves the on-disk transcript path for a given thread id by searching near a reference path.

nodes.name: collect_codex_impact_from_patch_apply_end
nodes.summary: Accumulates file-change impact metrics from a Codex patch_apply_end event payload.

nodes.name: collect_codex_impact_from_payload
nodes.summary: Dispatches a Codex event payload to the appropriate impact-collecting helper based on event type.

nodes.name: accumulate_patch_impact
nodes.summary: Accumulates added/removed line counts and touched file paths from a unified diff patch.

nodes.name: patch_file_path_from_line
nodes.summary: Extracts the file path referenced by a single diff header line.

nodes.name: normalize_patch_path
nodes.summary: Normalizes a patch file path by stripping diff prefixes and resolving relative segments.

nodes.name: load_codex_app_from_path
nodes.summary: Loads and fully parses a Codex session transcript file into canonical session metadata and activity chunks.

nodes.name: resolve_codex_tool_outputs
nodes.summary: Resolves pending tool call outputs against the recorded tool result payload for a Codex turn.

nodes.name: resolve_codex_call_group
nodes.summary: Groups related Codex tool calls together with their resolved output into a single call group chunk.

nodes.name: resolve_write_stdin_call
nodes.summary: Resolves a Codex write_stdin continuation call against its background tool call state.

nodes.name: record_stdin_event
nodes.summary: Records a stdin continuation event against the pending background tool call it targets.

nodes.name: emit_codex_call_group
nodes.summary: Emits a finalized tool call group chunk with its resolved output and exit code.

nodes.name: codex_exec_results
nodes.summary: Parses the raw output value of a Codex exec tool call into structured exec results.

nodes.name: codex_exec_result_from_text
nodes.summary: Parses a single exec result block of text into an output/session_id/exit_code structure.

nodes.name: codex_tool_call_chunk
nodes.summary: Builds a canonical tool-call activity chunk from a resolved Codex tool call and its output.

nodes.name: output_parts_for_tool_calls
nodes.summary: Splits the raw combined output value into per-call output fragments for a group of tool calls.

nodes.name: pending_tool_calls_from_payload
nodes.summary: Extracts pending function/tool call requests from a Codex event payload.

nodes.name: pending_custom_tool_calls_from_payload
nodes.summary: Extracts pending custom (non-standard) tool call requests from a Codex event payload.

nodes.name: web_search_call_from_payload
nodes.summary: Extracts a web-search tool call from a Codex event payload.

nodes.name: normalize_codex_tool_calls
nodes.summary: Normalizes a raw Codex tool call name and arguments into the app's canonical tool-call shape.

nodes.name: is_codex_shell_tool_key
nodes.summary: Checks whether a raw tool name refers to Codex's shell execution tool.

nodes.name: normalize_shell_args
nodes.summary: Normalizes raw shell tool call arguments into a canonical command/cwd structure.

nodes.name: normalize_write_stdin_args
nodes.summary: Normalizes raw write_stdin tool call arguments into canonical continuation input.

nodes.name: normalize_apply_patch_args
nodes.summary: Normalizes raw apply_patch tool call arguments into a canonical patch structure.

nodes.name: normalize_edit_args
nodes.summary: Normalizes raw file-edit tool call arguments (path, old/new content) into canonical form.

nodes.name: normalize_search_args
nodes.summary: Normalizes raw search tool call arguments into a canonical query structure.

nodes.name: normalize_web_search_args
nodes.summary: Normalizes raw web-search tool call arguments into a canonical query structure.

nodes.name: read_file_arg_values_from_shell_args
nodes.summary: Reverse-engineers file-read intents (path, offset, limit) from a raw shell command's arguments.

nodes.name: shell_read_args_to_value
nodes.summary: Converts resolved shell-derived file-read arguments into the canonical tool-call value shape.

nodes.name: split_shell_read_command_chain
nodes.summary: Splits a shell command string into a chain of piped sub-commands for individual parsing.

nodes.name: read_file_args_from_tokens
nodes.summary: Dispatches tokenized shell command arguments to the appropriate file-read pattern parser (cat/sed/head/tail/nl).

nodes.name: read_file_args_from_nl_sed_pipeline
nodes.summary: Parses a `nl | sed` shell pipeline into a file-read range (offset/limit).

nodes.name: read_file_path_from_nl
nodes.summary: Extracts the target file path from an `nl` shell command's tokens.

nodes.name: nl_option_consumes_next
nodes.summary: Determines whether an `nl` command-line flag consumes the following token as its value.

nodes.name: read_range_from_pipeline_sed
nodes.summary: Extracts a line range from a `sed` command used as part of a read pipeline.

nodes.name: read_file_args_from_cat
nodes.summary: Parses a `cat` shell command's tokens into a whole-file read intent.

nodes.name: read_file_args_from_sed
nodes.summary: Parses a standalone `sed` shell command into a file-read range intent.

nodes.name: read_file_args_from_head_tail
nodes.summary: Parses a `head`/`tail` shell command into a file-read range intent.

nodes.name: shell_path_args
nodes.summary: Extracts the positional path arguments from a tokenized shell command, honoring a flag allowlist.

nodes.name: single_shell_path_arg
nodes.summary: Returns the sole path argument from a list if exactly one is present.

nodes.name: sed_range_to_offset_limit
nodes.summary: Converts a `sed` line-range expression into an offset/limit pair.

nodes.name: sed_single_range_to_offset_limit
nodes.summary: Converts a single `sed` address expression into an offset/limit pair.

nodes.name: normalize_tool_name_key
nodes.summary: Normalizes a raw tool name string into a canonical lookup key.

nodes.name: rg_search_args_from_shell_args
nodes.summary: Reverse-engineers a structured search query from a raw `rg` (ripgrep) shell invocation.

nodes.name: exploration_tool_calls_from_shell_args
nodes.summary: Dispatches a shell command's arguments to the appropriate exploration tool parser (rg search/rg --files/find).

nodes.name: is_exploration_context_probe
nodes.summary: Detects shell commands that are lightweight directory/context probes rather than meaningful file operations.

nodes.name: rg_files_args_from_shell_args
nodes.summary: Parses an `rg --files` shell invocation into a structured directory-listing tool call.

nodes.name: find_args_from_shell_args
nodes.summary: Parses a `find` shell invocation into a structured directory-listing tool call.

nodes.name: option_values
nodes.summary: Extracts the values following given short/long option flags from a tokenized command.

nodes.name: has_only_output_limiter_pipeline
nodes.summary: Checks whether a shell pipeline consists only of output-limiting commands (head/tail/wc) with no semantic effect.

nodes.name: shell_tokens
nodes.summary: Tokenizes a raw shell command string, honoring quoting rules, into a list of argument tokens.

nodes.name: rg_pattern_from_tokens
nodes.summary: Extracts the search pattern argument from tokenized `rg` command-line arguments.

nodes.name: rg_flag_consumes_next
nodes.summary: Determines whether an `rg` command-line flag consumes the following token as its value.

nodes.name: first_apply_patch_file_path
nodes.summary: Returns the first file path referenced by an apply_patch payload.

nodes.name: parse_rg_output_matches
nodes.summary: Parses raw `rg` search output text into structured match records.

nodes.name: user_message_from_payload
nodes.summary: Extracts the user-authored message text from a Codex event payload.

nodes.name: session_title_from_payload
nodes.summary: Extracts a session title string from a Codex event payload.

nodes.name: content_text_from_payload
nodes.summary: Extracts plain text content from a Codex message content payload.

nodes.name: reasoning_text_from_payload
nodes.summary: Extracts model reasoning/thinking text from a Codex event payload.

nodes.name: resolve_codex_session_path
nodes.summary: Resolves the on-disk file path for a Codex session from its cached file_stem, checking known session directories.

nodes.name: codex_sessions_dirs
nodes.summary: Returns the list of known root directories where Codex CLI stores session transcripts.

nodes.name: codex_sessions_dir_candidates
nodes.summary: Builds candidate Codex session directory paths rooted at a given home directory.
